boundary_required_by_equation.stock: same government debt portfolio represented by effective_rate
boundary_required_by_equation.m: fraction of that exact stock whose effective coupon/rate is replaced or reset during the period
boundary_required_by_equation.marginal_rate: new effective rate applicable to the same repriced portion of that stock

official_evidence.definition: MoF average interest rates for selected debt instruments aggregated from the government debt portfolio; the strategy footnote describes a forecast-interest-payment / end-period-balance calculation for the instrument-level cost measure.
MoF average interest rate by debt portfolio/instrument; national- and foreign-currency costs reported separately.

official_evidence.observable: portfolio average interest rate and risk definitions
official_evidence.definition: Refinancing risk (debt due within one year / ATM) is explicitly separate from interest-rate risk (debt changing rate within one year / ATR).
Risk indicators calculated under national-legislation debt boundary; ATM and ATR are separately defined.

official_evidence.observable: domestic auction marginal/accepted yields by residual maturity
official_evidence.definition: Auction yields vary materially by maturity and apply only to issued domestic securities, not the entire stock or all refixing events.
Budget-execution interest expenditure is a flow for the consolidated budget and is not itself the effective rate on the exact MoF direct-debt stock used in the portfolio-cost tables.

reconciliation.reason: The refixing share combines debt that matures/refinances and debt whose contractual rate resets. A single marginal auction yield is not applicable to floating-rate resets, foreign-currency bonds, EU/IFI loans or all domestic maturities. The effective-rate stock is also an aggregate across currencies/instruments with heterogeneous costs.

missing_matched_inputs: period-by-period realized repriced principal by instrument/currency/rate-reset type
new/reset effective rate for each repriced block under the same classification
definitionally matched opening/closing debt stock and interest-cost measure
identifiability_diagnostic.why_no_estimation_is_run: Estimating m from aggregate average interest rates, redemptions and market yields would require synthetic allocation across currencies, maturity buckets and floating/fixed-rate resets, violating the preregistered boundary rule.

rejection_or_recovery_path.activation_gate: Only after the repricing ledger can reconstruct the published portfolio average-rate path within an explicit reconciliation tolerance without synthetic allocation.
